title: n8n every-N-minutes Schedule Trigger no longer fires on clock boundaries after upgrading to 2.45
symptoms: A workflow set to run every 15 minutes used to fire at :00, :15, :30, :45 and now fires at odd minutes
Runs are offset from the moment the workflow was published
Downstream systems expecting clock-aligned runs get data at unexpected times
cause: From n8n 2.45 the durable scheduler is the default for all Schedule Trigger nodes. Interval schedules in seconds and minutes now run a fixed N apart, counted from the publish time, instead of aligning to clock boundaries. Existing nodes switch over on upgrade without republishing.
fix: Either republish the workflow at the moment you want the cycle to start, switch to a cron expression for clock-aligned timing, or set N8N_SCHEDULER_TRIGGER_NODE_MODE=legacy to keep clock-aligned timing. Both legacy variables are deprecated and will be removed in a future version.
affected: n8n 2.45 and later, self-hosted and cloud, interval-based (seconds/minutes) Schedule Trigger nodes
